decks.module: Rural roads and limited night vision

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stay alert on quiet rural … rather than relaxing attention.”
cards.back: Stay alert on quiet rural roads, watch warnings and reduce speed for hazards rather than relaxing attention.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Gravel and dirt provide less … space for longer stops.”
cards.back: Gravel and dirt provide less grip than concrete or asphalt; slow down and increase following space for longer stops.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Potholes and rippled gravel or … disturb steering and control.”
cards.back: Potholes and rippled gravel or dirt surfaces can disturb steering and control.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “In dust on gravel roads, … leave more following room.”
cards.back: In dust on gravel roads, use low beams to improve visibility to others, slow down and leave more following room.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Narrow rural roads may have … stop for opposing traffic.”
cards.back: Narrow rural roads may have little shoulder and steep nearby ditches; watch narrow-bridge warnings and prepare to stop for opposing traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Slow and increase following room … dips or sharp bends.”
cards.back: Slow and increase following room on rural roads with unexpected dips or sharp bends.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Open metal bridge gratings reduce … and increase following room.”
cards.back: Open metal bridge gratings reduce braking and steering grip; slow, hold the wheel firmly and increase following room.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Trees and tall crops can … traffic near rural corners.”
cards.back: Trees and tall crops can hide traffic near rural corners.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Before a rural hillcrest or … watch for opposing vehicles.”
cards.back: Before a rural hillcrest or sharp curve, slow down, keep to the right and watch for opposing vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At rural railroad crossings, slow, … without gates or lights.”
cards.back: At rural railroad crossings, slow, look both ways and prepare to stop because a crossing may have signs without gates or lights.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Approach uncontrolled rural intersections cautiously … crossing or opposing traffic.”
cards.back: Approach uncontrolled rural intersections cautiously at lower speed and be ready to stop for crossing or opposing traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At night, headlights reveal less … making driving more difficult.”
cards.back: At night, headlights reveal less of the road than daylight, making driving more difficult.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook recommends dimming high … meeting an opposing vehicle.”
cards.back: The handbook recommends dimming high beams about one block before meeting an opposing vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “If an opposing driver uses … the road's right side.”
cards.back: If an opposing driver uses high beams, a single brief headlight flash may request dimming; if glare continues, look toward the road's right side.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not retaliate against high … own high beams on.”
cards.back: Do not retaliate against high beams by keeping the vehicle's own high beams on.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Use low beams when following … snowfall or heavy rain.”
cards.back: Use low beams when following another vehicle or driving in heavy traffic, fog, snowfall or heavy rain.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “High-beam light reflected by adverse … fog, snow or rain.”
cards.back: High-beam light reflected by adverse weather can create glare; equipped vehicles may use fog lights in fog, snow or rain.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Avoid staring into approaching headlights … can briefly impair vision.”
cards.back: Avoid staring into approaching headlights because glare can briefly impair vision.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At night, search far ahead … edges for side hazards.”
cards.back: At night, search far ahead for dark shapes and occasionally check both road edges for side hazards.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not use sunglasses or … they reduce useful vision.”
cards.back: Do not use sunglasses or tinted glasses at night or on dark days because they reduce useful vision.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Flooding may follow overflowing waterways, … floods can develop rapidly.”
cards.back: Flooding may follow overflowing waterways, failed dams or levees, melting snow runoff or rainfall, and flash floods can develop rapidly.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not drive into a … and choose another route.”
cards.back: Do not drive into a flooded road; turn around and choose another route.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not attempt a flooded … roadbed may be present.”
cards.back: Do not attempt a flooded crossing even if it looks shallow because hidden dips or a washed-out roadbed may be present.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “If no alternative flood-free route … for water to recede.”
cards.back: If no alternative flood-free route exists, move to higher ground and wait for water to recede.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Work zones may include lane … long-term at any season.”
cards.back: Work zones may include lane closures, detours or moving equipment and can be temporary or long-term at any season.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Cones, barrels, signs, large vehicles … and guide its traffic.”
cards.back: Cones, barrels, signs, large vehicles and workers in bright clothing can signal a work zone and guide its traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Orange work-zone signs convey instructions, … notice and speed information.”
cards.back: Orange work-zone signs convey instructions, advance notice and speed information.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Without a reduced work-zone limit, … posted limit still applies.”
cards.back: Without a reduced work-zone limit, the ordinary posted limit still applies.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “In work zones, monitor surrounding … and increase following space.”
cards.back: In work zones, monitor surrounding traffic, obey signs and flaggers, reduce speed as needed and increase following space.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Work-zone lane patterns may change … ignore familiar long-term signs.”
cards.back: Work-zone lane patterns may change daily; do not ignore familiar long-term signs.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook recommends moving to … work zone when possible.”
cards.back: The handbook recommends moving to the appropriate lane at the first notice of an approaching work zone when possible.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Use added caution at night … when workers are absent.”
cards.back: Use added caution at night in a work zone even when workers are absent.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When possible, position the vehicle … by workers or equipment.”
cards.back: When possible, position the vehicle away from the side occupied by workers or equipment.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Some roadwork moves along the … until the end-of-work notice.”
cards.back: Some roadwork moves along the road, including painting, patching and mowing; continue obeying signs until the end-of-work notice.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Allow extra travel time for … alternate route when possible.”
cards.back: Allow extra travel time for work-zone delays or choose an alternate route when possible.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not swerve into opposing … to avoid an animal.”
cards.back: Do not swerve into opposing traffic or off the road to avoid an animal.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “An abrupt animal-avoidance maneuver may … during and after impact.”
cards.back: An abrupt animal-avoidance maneuver may cause a more severe crash; maintaining vehicle control is the priority before, during and after impact.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook recommends additional animal … during October through December.”
cards.back: The handbook recommends additional animal caution at dawn and dusk and during October through December.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Be alert at deer-crossing signs, … history of deer-vehicle collisions.”
cards.back: Be alert at deer-crossing signs, which identify areas with a history of deer-vehicle collisions.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Search well ahead and to … near woods and water.”
cards.back: Search well ahead and to both sides for animals, including reflected eye shine at night near woods and water.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Slow near roadside animals because … other deer may follow.”
cards.back: Slow near roadside animals because they may change direction abruptly and other deer may follow.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Hazard flashers can warn other … or beside the road.”
cards.back: Hazard flashers can warn other drivers of animals on or beside the road.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When time permits avoiding an … and use the horn.”
cards.back: When time permits avoiding an animal, reduce speed, tap the brakes to warn followers and use the horn.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “With no vehicle close behind, … wheel lock and skidding.”
cards.back: With no vehicle close behind, the handbook permits hard braking to avoid an animal while avoiding wheel lock and skidding.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “If striking an animal is … road rather than swerving.”
cards.back: If striking an animal is unavoidable, keep control and remain on the road rather than swerving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Report a collision with a … farm animal, to police.”
cards.back: Report a collision with a large animal, such as a deer or farm animal, to police.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “If a struck animal is … without entering anyone's home.”
cards.back: If a struck animal is a pet and homes are nearby, try to notify its owner when possible without entering anyone's home.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Pets can enter the roadway … rural and farm areas.”
cards.back: Pets can enter the roadway in residential, rural and farm areas.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.
